25325.overview: You're on the pitch, ready to kick off. The crowd is going crazy. The season has been long and challenging. You've been up against a lot of teams and come out on top, and today's the day - to prove that you have the skill and determination to become the Ultimate Soccer champion!

25326.overview: Save the cities of the U.S.A. from Armageddon in ten spectacular multiple-stage missions! Leave your copter and fight on foot. New choppers and ground assault vehicles. New timed sequences, power-ups and interactive control panels.
